lines.en: Freya, you look upset. What happened on your way to the station this morning?
lines.pt: Freya, você parece chateado. O que aconteceu a caminho da estação esta manhã?

lines.en: A police officer stopped me. She asked me where I was going and why I was in a hurry.
lines.pt: Uma policial me parou. Ela perguntou aonde eu ia e por que eu estava com pressa.

lines.en: How strange! Did she ask you what you had in your bag as well?
lines.pt: Que estranho! Ela também perguntou o que você tinha na bolsa?

lines.en: She did. She asked me what was inside it and whether I lived nearby.
lines.pt: Perguntou. Quis saber o que havia dentro dela e se eu morava por perto.

lines.en: I hope you told her that you work at the hospital. Did she seem suspicious?
lines.pt: Espero que tenha dito que trabalha no hospital. Ela parecia desconfiada?

lines.en: Very. She asked me why I had left home so early on a Sunday.
lines.pt: Muito. Ela perguntou por que eu tinha saído de casa tão cedo num domingo.

lines.en: My neighbour was stopped too. He said the police asked him how long he had lived in Boston.
lines.pt: Meu vizinho também foi parado. Ele disse que a polícia perguntou há quanto tempo ele morava em Boston.

lines.en: Then she was probably looking for a witness. She asked me if I had seen a man in a grey coat.
lines.pt: Então ela provavelmente procurava uma testemunha. Perguntou se eu tinha visto um homem de casaco cinza.

lines.en: Ah, the robbery! Someone told me that a shop on Elm Street had been robbed last night.
lines.pt: Ah, o roubo! Alguém me disse que uma loja da Elm Street tinha sido assaltada ontem à noite.

lines.en: That explains it. I asked her what she was looking for, but she would not tell me anything.
lines.pt: Isso explica tudo. Perguntei o que ela procurava, mas ela não quis me contar nada.

lines.en: I am curious now. Let us ask the shop owner whether they have caught the thief.
lines.pt: Agora fiquei curiosa. Vamos perguntar ao dono da loja se já pegaram o ladrão.

facts.big: She asked me where I was going
facts.label: Perguntas reportadas
facts.sub: Depois de asked, use ordem de afirmação e passe o verbo para o passado: She asked me where I was going.

facts.label: perguntou onde / o que / por que
facts.sub: Use asked me + palavra da pergunta + sujeito + verbo: She asked me where I was going. A ordem é de afirmação, sem do nem did, e o verbo vai para o passado.

facts.label: perguntou se
facts.sub: Para perguntas de sim ou não, use if ou whether: She asked me if I had seen him. O tempo também recua um passo: have seen vira had seen.

compare.ask: She asked me where I was going.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela perguntou aonde eu ia”, e a ordem das palavras já é de afirmação.
compare.tip: Diga: “She asked me where I was going.”
compare.us: Em inglês, a pergunta reportada também vira afirmação: She asked me where I was going, e não “where was I going”. Sem do ou did, sem ponto de interrogação, e o verbo vai para o passado.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: She asked me where I was going.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: A Sunday morning in Boston · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Sunday morning in Boston. Dan arrives at Fay’s kitchen with red cheeks. He cannot stop thinking about a strange meeting. Fay pours him a cup of hot tea. Both friends like to talk about what happened. Today they practise how to report questions.

“Dan, you look upset. What happened on your way to the station this morning?” says Fay. “A police officer stopped me. She asked me where I was going and why I was in a hurry.” says Dan. “How strange! Did she ask you what you had in your bag as well?” says Fay.

pages.title: A Sunday morning in Boston · 3/3
paragraphs: “That explains it. I asked her what she was looking for, but she would not tell me anything.” says Dan. “I am curious now. Let us ask the shop owner whether they have caught the thief.” says Fay. Dan finishes his tea and feels calmer. Fay thinks the police were only doing their job. They decide to walk to Elm Street together. On the way, Dan repeats the officer’s questions. Fay corrects his grammar with a smile. Reported questions help us tell any story clearly.

pages.title: Encontre a frase natural

opts: She asked me where I was going.
She asked me where I am going to.
She asked me where was I going.
items.why: Em perguntas reportadas, use a ordem de afirmação: where I was going.

opts: He asked me what I wanted.
He asked me what did I want.
He asked me what I do want.
items.why: Não use did em pergunta reportada: what I wanted.

opts: She asked me where do I live.
She asked me where I lived.
She asked me where I live to.
items.why: Depois de asked, o verbo vai para o passado e sem do.

opts: He said me where he was going.
He told me where he was going.
He asked me where he was going to.
items.why: Use told me ou asked me, nunca said me.

pages.instruction: Escolha a forma que resolve a situação; explique o erro comum.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Escolha a frase mais natural. → She asked me where I was going.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → He asked me what I wanted.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → She asked me where I lived.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → He told me where he was going.
